{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (e.g., 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude after recent spikes (e.g., >70) to avoid overshoots.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if price has been trending upward for 3+ days, slightly dampen forecast growth.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts: if sentiment rises from 0.00 to 0.50, adjust upward by 2-5%.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is significantly higher than 3-day moving average, adjust forecast upward by 1-3%.",
    "Avoid overconfidence in high sentiment periods: if sentiment > 0.50, cap forecast growth to prevent overestimation.",
    "For 30-day horizon, reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is flat (0.00) to avoid noise amplification."
  ]
}
